objectives.title: Demonstration of Consent
objectives.description: The contract contains terms establishing records proving data subject consent.
criteria: Provisions requiring records to be kept evidencing that data subject consent was obtained.
Provisions specifying retention of consent records for as long as necessary to demonstrate consent.
Provisions addressing provider support in producing consent evidence to the controller on request.

objectives.title: Presentation of Consent Requests
objectives.description: The documentation contains specifications ensuring consent requests remain separate from other contractual terms.
criteria: Terms requiring consent requests be clearly distinguishable from general contractual clauses.
Provisions mandating intelligible presentation formats for consent.
Clauses requiring easily accessible formats for consent requests.

objectives.title: Consent Withdrawal Execution
objectives.description: The contract defines procedures enabling data subjects to revoke consent at any time.
criteria: Clauses securing the right to revoke consent at any point.
Terms confirming the legality of prior processing remains unaffected by withdrawal.
Provisions requiring pre-consent notification of withdrawal rights.
Mechanisms ensuring withdrawal difficulty matches granting difficulty.

objectives.title: Non-Conditional Service Delivery
objectives.description: The contract addresses the separation of service delivery from non-essential processing consent.
criteria: Provisions prohibiting service denial based solely on refusal of non-essential processing consent.
Clauses assessing the necessity of processing activities relative to the primary contract.
Provisions allowing the data subject to consent separately to non-necessary processing, independent of acceptance of the core service terms.
